an3.21:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an3.21:1.3: Atha kho āyasmā ca Saviṭṭho āyasmā ca Mahākoṭṭhito yen' āyasmā Sāriputto ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu. Upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu . . .
an3.21:1.4: pe . . . Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ Saviṭṭhaṃ āyasmā Sāriputto etad avoca:
an3.21:2.1: Tayo 'me āvuso Saviṭṭha puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an3.21:2.4: Ime kho āvuso tayo puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an3.21:2.5: Imesaṃ āvuso tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ katamo te puggalo khamati abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cā ti?
an3.21:3.1: Tayo 'me āvuso Sāriputta puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an3.21:3.4: Ime kho āvuso tayo puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an3.21:3.5: Imesaṃ āvuso tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ yvāyaṃ puggalo saddhāvimutto ayaṃ me puggalo khamati imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro ca.
an3.21:3.7: Imassa āvuso puggalassa saddhindriyaṃ adhimattan ti.

an3.21:7.7: Imassa āvuso puggalassa paññindriyaṃ adhimattan ti.
an3.21:8.1: Atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto āyasmantaṃ Saviṭṭhaṃ āyasmantañ ca Mahākoṭṭhitaṃ etad avoca:
an3.21:8.2: Vyākataṃ kho āvuso amhehi sabbeh' eva yathā sakaṃ paṭibhānaṃ,
an3.21:8.3: āyām' āvuso yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkamissāma. Upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocessāma.
an3.21:8.4: Yathā no Bhagavā vyākarissati tathā naṃ dhārissāmā ti.
an3.21:8.5: Evaṃ āvuso ti kho āyasmā ca Saviṭṭho āyasmā ca Mahākoṭṭhito āyasmato Sāriputtassa paccassosuṃ.
an3.21:8.6: Atha kho āyasmā ca Sāriputto āyasmā ca Saviṭṭho āyasmā ca Mahākoṭṭhito yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu. Upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
an3.21:8.7: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Sāriputto yāvatako ahosi āyasmatā ca Saviṭṭhena āyasmatā ca Mahākoṭṭhitena saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo taṃ sabbaṃ Bhagavato ārocesi.
an3.21:9.1: Na khv ettha Sāriputta sukaraṃ ekaṃsena vyākātuṃ
an3.21:9.2: ayaṃ imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cā ti. Ṭhānaṃ h'
an3.21:9.3: etaṃ Sāriputta vijjati yvāyaṃ puggalo saddhāvimutto svāyaṃ arahattāya paṭipanno yvāyaṃ puggalo kāyasakkhī svāyaṃ sakadāgāmī vā anāgāmī vā yo cāyaṃ puggalo diṭṭhippatto so p' assa sakadāgāmī vā anāgāmī vā.
